title: Investors File Class Action Lawsuit Against Intel After Stock Plunge
excerpt: A proposed class action lawsuit alleges Intel concealed slowing sales impacts, leading to inflated share values before a major stock drop.
body_html: Intel is facing a proposed class action lawsuit from investors following a significant 29% drop in its stock value. According to the legal action, the chip manufacturer allegedly concealed the true impact of slowing sales, which ultimately inflated the price of its shares.
